Accessories
source_pages.raw_wikitext:
{{Infobox/Generic
|image=File:Accessory Bag.png
}}
'''Accessories''' are a category of items that grant buffs while held in a player's inventory or {{Item|Accessory Bag}}. While in the {{Item|Accessory Bag}}, they grant {{MP}}, which is a stat that improves [[Powers]] and grants [[Tuning Points]].

== Overview ==
'''Accessories''', while in the {{Item|Accessory Bag}}, grant [[Stats|stat]] buffs and abilities to the player. Additionally, each unique Accessory in the {{Item|Accessory Bag}} grants {{MP}} depending on its rarity.

=== Accessory Power ===
{{Main|Accessory Power}}
{{:Accessory Power/Mechanics}}

=== Enrichments ===
{{Main|Enrichments}}
'''Enrichments''' are items that can be applied to Accessories that are {{Legendary}} or higher. They can be purchased from {{NPCSprite|Elizabeth}} for {{Bits|5,000}} per and grant small stat boosts. An {{Item|Accessory Enrichment Swapper}} can be used to swap the applied '''Enrichment''' on all enriched Accessories.

=== Accessory Lines & Priority ===
Some '''Accessories''' can be upgraded into higher tiers through a variety of methods. The order in which most '''Accessories''' upgrade are as follows:

: '''Talisman → {{Green|Ring}} → {{Blue|Artifact}} → {{DarkPurple|Relic}} → {{Gold|Heirloom}}'''{{Footnote|The only {{Green|2}} Heirlooms in the game are the {{Item|Freshly Baked Heirloom}} and {{Item|Crux Heirloom}}. Generally, most Relics are {{Legendary}} instead.}}

Note that some Accessories do not start at {{Common}} or as a Talisman (e.g. {{Item|Devour Ring}}); some Accessories will skip a tier (e.g. {{Item|Burststopper Talisman}} and {{Item|Burststopper Artifact}}); and some Accessories will not be the rarity that their suffix suggests (e.g. the {{Item|Dwarven Metal Talisman}} is {{Uncommon}}; the {{Item|Tarantula Ring}} is {{Legendary}}).

Certain Accessories will take priority over others:
* If two or more of the same Accessory are in the player's inventory or {{Item|Accessory Bag}}, their effects and {{MP}} will not stack.
* If several Accessories of the same upgrade tree are in the player's {{Item|Accessory Bag}}, only the Accessory of the highest tier will take effect and grant {{MP}}. For example, if the player has a {{Item|Freshly Baked Relic}} and {{Item|Freshly Baked Heirloom}}, '''only''' the latter will take effect.

{{Ahn|exclusive=yes}} {{Infobox/Character |dont_submit_to_bucket = Yes |location=Village |x=2 |y=77 |z=-5 }} '''Centauri''' is an [[NPC]] exclusive to the [[Alpha Hypixel Network|Alpha Network]]. They are located in front of the {{zone|Community Center}}, and grant {{c}}, {{Item|Booster Cookie}}s, item upgrades and update-featured items. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Usage == '''Centauri''' can be accessed by talking to them in the Hub, or via the {{code|/centauri}} command anywhere. The interface has three parts. === Featured Update Items === {{Quote|Claim featured items related to this update.}} This menu is a shop that sells items featured in an update for {{Coins|1}} each. === Coin Generator === This menu gives player any amount of money. Available options are: {{Coins|1k}}, {{Coins|10k}}, {{Coins|100k}}, {{Coins|1m}}, {{Coins|10m}}, {{Coins|100m}}, {{Coins|1b}}, and "Custom Amount". === Toy Box === {{Quote|A variety of useful and cheaty utilities to make your life easier!}} This menu contains other features available to the player. These features applies an effect to a player, and are claimable for any amount of times and without cool down. {| class="wikitable" ! Feature !! Description |- | Cookie Jar | When clicked, it gives the player the effect of a {{Item|Booster Cookie}}, as if the player has consumed one.
Duration granted: {{Green|292,471,155 years, 208 days, 9 hours and 15 minutes}} in real-life time |- | Potion Seller | When clicked, it gives the player all potion effects of a {{Item|God Potion}}, as if the player has consumed one.
Duration granted: {{Green|292,471,155 years, 208 days, 9 hours and 15 minutes}} in real-life time |- | Max Items | When clicked, it makes the following changes to all armor pieces and items in the player's inventory (not including items in [[Storage]] and [[Wardrobe]]) if applicable: * Maximum [[Enchantments]] * [[Recombobulator 3000#Usage|Recombobulate]] * A fixed [[Reforge]] depending on the item's type, overriding any existing reforge on the item. If there is no set reforge for that category, the previous reforge, if any, stays on the item. Currently, this feature does not change any [[Gemstone]] slot on items. |- | Duplicate Items | When clicked when holding an item, it duplicates the item in the player's inventory. |- | Max Collections | When clicked, for all [[Collection]] items that has not reached its maximum tier, the collection amount is set to the requirement for the highest tier, meaning all tiers are unlocked. |- | Max Skills | When clicked, for all [[Skills]] that has not reached its maximum level except {{Skill|Dungeoneering}}, its skill XP is set to an arbitrarily high number, meaning all levels are unlocked. |- | Max Slayers | When clicked, all [[Slayer|Slayers]] are increased to their maximum level. |- | 50k HOTM EXP | When clicked, the player instantly gains 50,000 [[HotM Experience|HotM EXP]]. |- | Big 'ol chunk o' Powder! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 2,000,000 [[Mithril Powder|Mithril]] and [[Gemstone Powder|Gemstone]] powder. |- | 5k Gems | When clicked, the player's [[Gems]] purse is set to {{Green|5,000}}. |- | Set RNG Meter Progress | When clicked, the player is prompted to enter an amount of XP for all the player's [[RNG Meter]]s progress to be set to. |- | Clear RNG Meter Progress | When clicked, the player's RNG Meters' progress is set to 0. |- | Fill Agatha's Rewards | Gives you rewards for [[Agatha]]'s contests as if you had participated in 25 of them. |- | Big 'ol chunk o' Whispers! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 1,000,000 {{Turquoise|Forest Whispers}}. |- | Shards! | When clicked, the player instantly gains 10 of every available {{Item|Attribute Shard}}. |- |} ==== Reforges ==== '''Centauri''' applies the following reforges when using Max Items: {| class="wikitable centertext" |- ! Type ! Make sure to talk to Sam on your private island to go to the Garden if you are at least SkyBlock level 5!}} |- | class="ct" rowspan="2" | After finishing [[Sam]]'s introduction | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &8&lCentauri&r: Welcome.}} |- | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &8&lCentauri&r: Hello There.}} |} == Trivia == *'''Centauri''''s comments when the player claims potion effects is a reference to the infamous [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R_FQU4KzN7A potion seller meme]. *'''Centauri''''s skin is based off [https://www.destinypedia.com/Xûr Xûr] from the Destiny franchise. *'''Centauri''' and the fact that they are exclusive to the [[Alpha Hypixel Network|Alpha Network]] is a reference to the triple star system [[w:Alpha Centauri|Alpha Centauri]]. *The line "I solemnly swear I am up to no good.", despite not being verbatim, comes from Harry Potter, where it was used to access the [[fandom:harrypotter:Marauder's_Map#Usage|Marauder's Map]]. *The max collection feature works for [[Jacob's Farming Contest]]s and can be clicked multiple times to max the collections over and over. *The maximum number of coins that can be generated at once is 2^{63}-1 = 9,223,372,036,854,775,807 (9.223 quintillion or 9.223372e+18), which is the 64-bit signed integer limit. However, this can be repeated multiple times, and the player's purse can hold more than that. *It is possible to generate a negative amount of coins, which will take coins from your purse instead of adding to it. **It used to be possible to make your purse go negative with this, but that appears to have been patched. *You can duplicate an item even if your inventory is full. options in Toy Box|Featured Items has Mining items for the [[Glacite Tunnels]]}} {{History|2024/April 9|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' again featuring|No items are featured in this Alpha session and Centauri's UI and dialogue are still left over from the previous session}} {{History|2024/April 9|'''Centauri''' is updated to change the name of his GUI for the featured update and to replace his dialogue}} {{History|2024/May 3|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' having new dialogue and featured items for Dragons}} {{History|2024/June 3|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Added 5k Gems option in Toy Box.|Featured Items has items for Better Mayors.}} {{History|unknown|'''Centauri''' can now be accessed anywhere via the {{code|/centauri}} command.}} {{History|2024/June 10|link=none|Updated Featured Items for the Better Mayors update.}} {{History|2024/July 31|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items has items for Artist's Abode.}} {{History|2024/August 20|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items has items for Modernized Mining.}} {{History|2024/Sept 11|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items are the same as previous appearance.|Alpha Checklist is not available.}} {{History|2024/Oct 2|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items contains only {{Item|Dirt}}.|Alpha Checklist is not available.|Fixed Duplicate Item not working when not in the Hub.}} {{History|2024/Nov 13|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items contains items for the 0.20.8 update.|Alpha Checklist is not available.}} {{History|2025/Jan 15|Alpha Hypixel Network reopens with '''Centauri''' returning.|Featured Items contains items for the 0.21.1 update.|Alpha Checklist is not available.}} }}

[[File:Cult of the Fallen Star Screenshot.png|thumb|290x290px|The cult in the game]]
The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' is a secret cult found in the {{zone|Cliffside Veins}} in the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} at {{Coordinates|-45|193|45}}. To find the cult, players need to arrive between 0 AM and 6 AM in-game time on either the 7th, 14th, 21st or 28th day of each SkyBlock month. The entrance to the cult's cave is at {{Coordinates|-26|198|40}}. After going to a meeting, the player will obtain the {{ach|The Cult of the Fallen Star|ach=true}}.

After speaking to {{NPCSprite|Brarnas}} for the first time, players will be given the [[Fallen Star Helmet]]. In subsequent meetings with the cult, when the player wears the [[Fallen Star Helmet]], they will receive {{Item|Starfall|amount=200}}.

[[Silnar]] is also a member of the '''Cult''', who gives the player a [[Fallen Star Lozenge]].

== Location ==
The cult's cave is located in a hidden area of {{Zone|Cliffside Veins}}; specifically, it is west of the purple crystal and up the cliff. Players can use the lava channel in the {{Zone|Lava Springs}} to access the location without having to use ender pearls.

&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You know, now that I think of it, everything is really blocky around here. And everywhere.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: But it is a wheel!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: How can you be so sure?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Because everyone calls it a wheel!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Have you ever seen one turn?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Now that I think about it, no. I've never seen a minecart actually move. They're always in the same place!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: The same is true for me.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Then what are they there for? Just for decoration?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Guys... are we living in a simulation?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Don't be silly.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Unlikely. There's no way to prove we're living in a simulation.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Come, let's go and check out those minecarts. Meeting adjourned!}}

| class="ct" | Fifth Meeting
| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Ah, &7<Player>&f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You’ve now attended &65&f meetings of the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f! As a reward, here's some &9Starfall&f!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Well, guys, I'm still a bit shook from our recent series of discoveries.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: I suppose we should recap them, just for the agenda. &5Brarnas&f, if you would...
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Sure.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Firstly, we discovered that the wheels on minecarts are solely for show, and that minecarts cannot actually move.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Next, &5Thondin&f made the realization that food actually has no taste or texture, though we are inclined to eat it.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Then, we realized that fallen stars always land at the same few spots. Mathematically unlikely, to put it lightly.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: After which, we noted that the same things always happen at the same time, each day.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Yup!
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: &dBednom&f always has a &dnightmare&f.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: &6Brynmor&f always loses his &cSpeckled Teacup&f.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: &eFetchur&f always needs someone to bring him something.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: And the &dPuzzler&f always has a stupid puzzle to solve!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Indeed. It seems almost as if everyone here is living the same day, again and again.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: And, when we asked them about it, none of them knew why they do what they do!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Indeed. With this in mind, only one logical conclusion can be reached.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: What is it?
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: We... are living in a &kX&rsimulation&kX&r.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: HUH?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: I can't deal with this right now, I need some time to process it all.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: To think I was right all along.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Meeting adjourned!}}
|-
| class="ct" | Sixth Meeting
| {{Dialogue|
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Ah, &7<Player>&f! Nice to see you at our cult meeting!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: You’ve now attended &66&f meetings of the &5Cult of the Fallen Star&f! As a reward, here's some &9Starfall&f!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Now, time for the meeting to begin!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: I don't know about you guys, but I'm still coming to terms with our recent findings...
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: I can't believe it...
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: We really are living in a &kX&rsimulation&kX&r!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: It is unfortunate. Though we are certain of it, there's simply nothing we can do.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: The moment all of the "players" leave the game, we shall cease to exist until they return.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Please don't leave, &7<Player>&f, I don't want to die!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: What was never alive may never die, &5Thondin&f.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: But we are conscious, &5Brarnas&f, are we not? Surely we exist in some capacity.
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Or do we merely feign consciousness? Perhaps we are nothing more than the simulation experiencing itself.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Or perhaps we are real, but are stuck within the &kX&rsimulation&kX&r?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: This is all too much for me to comprehend. I liked things better before.
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: How about we order a pizza?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Let's do it.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Alright, let me call them.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Hello, can I have a pizza please.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Hmm, give me a second, I'll ask my friends.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Guys, &cred pizza&f or &9blue pizza&f?
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Ooh, a &9blue pizza&f! That's my favorite!
&e[NPC] &5Brarnas&f: Yes, I suppose we should go for the blue. It feels... familiar. Have we had it before?
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: I don't think so. Let's get it.
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Hey! One &9blue pizza&f, please. Yup, thanks, we'll come over now, bye!
&e[NPC] &5Dalir&f: Alright guys, let's go grab our pizza! And no more talk of all of this &kX&rsimulation&kX&r stuff, it scares me!
&e[NPC] &5Thondin&f: Hopefully it'll all be over when we wake up tomorrow...

== Trivia ==
*Meetings, except for the gap between the meetings on the 28th and the 7th, are 7 in-game days apart (2 hours and 20 minutes in real life time).
*'''Dalir''' is the only cult member players can interact with.
*Despite the message saying "come back next time" if you forget to wear the helmet, you can simply put on the helmet and then talk to Brarnas again to receive the {{Item|Starfall}}.
*The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' is likely the antithesis to the [[Armor of the Rising Sun|Rising Sun]] as they share the same naming scheme.
*There is a [[Fairy Soul]] at {{Coords|-52|205|48}}, which is accessed from their room.
*'''Thondin''' states that his favourite food is blue pizza during cult meeting #6.
**The red and blue pizzas are a reference to [[w:The Matrix|The Matrix]]'s red pill and blue pill, where the red pill represents learning an unsettling truth, and the blue pill represents remaining in comfortable ignorance.
*The '''Cult of the Fallen Star''' members are one of 5 [[NPC]]'s to mention the "simulation" or the simulated state of the world of skyblock. Others include the [[Royal Resident]], [[Oen]], [[Yoshua]], and [[Skylark]].

source_pages.title: Dante
source_pages.raw_wikitext: {{Infobox/Mayor |aka = Mayor Dante }} '''Dante''' was a one time special Mayoral Candidate that appeared in the Year 128 [[Mayor Election]]. He offered three perks, Order, Security and Freedom, which changed once he was elected. After Dante was elected, [[Clerk Seraphine]] started building the [[The Uprising|Resistance Movement]] at the [[Dark Auction]], which lead to an election for the [[Resistance Leader]] to lead [[Resistance Movement|The Uprising]], the final boss fight in which players kill Dante. [[File:Dante Banner.png|alt=Dante's banner|thumb|Dante's banner]] == Mayoral Perks == Most special mayors run with up to four unique perks, but Dante has only been seen with three perks. '''Perks''': #'''Order''': Establish order #'''Security''': Strengthen security #'''Freedom''': Freedom from fear However, when Dante was elected, his real perks are revealed and are as follows: '''Changes List''': * Economy Restoration (Establish Order) ** Double [[Auction House|AH]] & [[Bazaar]] Tax ** 10% [[Coins|coin]] tax on [[Shops]] *** All NPC items have had their price increased by 10%. This did not affect selling items to NPCs. ** {{c|10}} per minute fee for chatting ** {{c|2}} toll on travelling between islands *** This perk did not affect the /warpforge command. * Increase Security (Strengthen Security) ** Hired goons to protect [[Official Buildings|official buildings]] *** [[Goons]] would deny entry to most of the [[Official Buildings|public buildings]], excluding the [[Community Center]] where Dante is located, for players who were not wearing [[Happy Mask]] or did not have a [[Dante's Talisman]] with them. ** Cancelled hazardous events *** The [[Traveling Zoo]], [[Spooky Festival]] and [[Season of Jerry|Season of Jerry Event]] were canceled. The [[New Year Celebration]] was still held. *** The [[Mayor Election|Mayor Elections]] were replaced with [[Mayor Election#Dante Election|Dante Elections]], where only Dante could be elected. ** Decreased sunlight, prevent sunburn *** The time of the day on the entire server was set to midnight, no matter what the actual in-game time was. This perk was not added until several days after Dante was elected. (This didn't affect islands with a [[Day Saver]].) * In the hours leading up to [[The Uprising]], Dante introduced several more changes: ** [[Dungeons]] were banned, which means no players could participate in Dungeons. ** [[Pets]] were disabled, meaning no Pets could be equipped. ** The alliance with the Dwarves was disbanded, barring access to the [[Dwarven Mines]]. ** The [[Auction House|AH]] and [[Bazaar]] were disabled, preventing people from buying items. ** Eventually, traveling between islands itself was banned, forcing everyone into the [[Hub]] to fight Dante. All of Dante's changes were reverted when [[Technoblade]] became mayor following [[The Uprising]]. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {{/Dialogue}} == Message in the Hub, from Dante == After the popular Hypixel YouTuber Technoblade went [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hv5tNAG1r_c live] about the [[Resistance Movement]], a [https://twitter.com/HypixelNetwork/status/1379932943062167552 Twitter message] from Hypixel's official Twitter, revealed a message from Dante. This message replaces the map in the [[Hub]]. {{Collapsible Section Button|Click to see Dante's message|id=dante-message}} {{Collapsible Section|[[File:Dante MSG.jpg|512px]]|id=dante-message}} == Boss Fight == {{Infobox/Generic |image=Huge_Slime.png }} [[File:Ruins of the Hub Dante.jpg|thumb|The Hub in ruins after the Dante boss fight|alt=]] During the boss fight against the [[The Uprising|Resistance]], Dante unleashed [[Goons]] into the hub. Once they were defeated, he morphed into a giant Slime and started destroying the [[Hub Island|Hub]]. He could only be damaged using the [[Staff of the Rising Sun]]. Receiving damage from Dante would result in the following message: {{Dialogue|&c&lDante &r&cstruck you for # damage!}} During the boss fight players were able to look up to support [[Resistance Leader|Technoblade]]. Doing so resulted in the following message in the chat: {{Dialogue|&b&lENERGY BALL&r&e: You are sending mana to &dTechnoblade&e!}} After Dante was defeated, the following message appeared in the chat: {{Dialogue|$[c]&e&l{{Dashline}} &b&lDANTE IS NO MORE! &b&lIT TOOK AN ARMY OF TENS OF THOUSANDS! &b&lBUT WE PREVAILED! &b&lTHE SUN RISES AGAIN! &b&lTIME TO START REBUILDING OUR VILLAGE! $[c]&e&l{{Dashline}}}} == Dante Tomb == After [https://hypixel.net/threads/skyblock-0-11-4.4145813|Patch 0.11.4], Dante's Tomb appeared in the [[Graveyard]] at {{Coordinates|-89|75|-133}}. The tomb features mostly gray palate-type blocks of Stone and some Cobblestone Walls. There is a gray Dante statue standing on top of the tomb. Clicking the statue shows the following message in chat: {{Dialogue|&7In Memoriam &7While Dante will be remembered as a cruel tyrant, his righteous ideals live on in people's hearts. &7dante &6best}} == Trivia == * Jayavarmen mentioned a new special candidate in a [https://twitter.com/jayavarmen/status/1376941661733982221 tweet] stating, "don't vote for them." This ended up to be Dante. * '''Dante''' seems to be the opposite of [[Derpy]], as [[Derpy]] appears to want chaos while Dante wants order. * '''Dante''' is the fourth special mayor, replacing the spot of [[Derpy]] in Year 128. * When he got elected, a secret [[Resistance Movement|movement]] in the [[Dark Auction|Dark Auction House]] appeared. * Before April 12, one wouldn't lose coins upon dying even if they didn't have a Cookie Buff or a Piggy Bank. This turned out to be a glitch and got patched. * Dante, once he got elected: ** Introduced a new soundtrack (made by ShinkoNet) into the [[Hub Island|Hub]]. ** Drained the color from buildings in the [[Hub Island|Hub]] and modified them. For example, the fish on the [[Fish Merchant|Fish Merchant's]] house turned into a fish skeleton and the [[Event Stand]] was boarded up. ** Changed the [[Hub Island|Hub]] biome to desert. ** Replaced the well in the [[Village]] with his [[Golden Dante Statue|statue]]. ** Replaced normal [[Mayor Election|Mayor Elections]] with [[Mayor Election#Dante Election|Dante Elections]] in which he's the only candidate. ** Changed the result of the [[Mayor Election|election]] he's been elected in into 100% votes for him, in-game displayed as "100% - All Votes" instead of the true percentage and amount of votes. ** Added a message from him against the resistance replacing the hub map, lasting for the time he is elected. ** Hung green-gray-black banners on some buildings in the [[Hub Island|Hub]]. * The message Dante had in the [[Hub Island|Hub]] had a chance to be glitched on some lobbies. * After [[The Uprising]] has ended, saying "dante" in the chat triggered the in-game swear filter. This was removed a few weeks later. * Dante introduced 3 soundtracks, which are [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hVQoq_7ErXo Dark and Seedy], [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UzNqODe-bvg Dark and Seedy (Pre-Revolt)] and [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oWXmQZnfRps Breathless Encounter]. * When in boss form, even though Dante had a health bar, when he reached the wizard tower his health bar would always drop to 0%, no matter what. * The [[Commands|command]] {{Code|/killdante}} was used in Technoblade's Uprising livestream. The command is now disabled. ** The command was later referenced with {{NPCSprite|Bacte}} and {{NPCSprite|Aura}}. * A memorial to Dante exists in the [[Graveyard]] at {{Coordinates|-90|75|-130}}. You can find more information [[Graveyard#Dante_Memorial|here]]. * Dante and [[Bacte]] share a striking resemblance, but aren't necessarily related. * According to [[Elise (Rift)|Elise]], Wizards believe that [[Shen]] employed, or perhaps even created '''Dante'''. Another possibility is that [[Shen]] got in the [[Rift Dimension]] before the Wizards, and found Dante there. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2021/March 31|[[File:Dante.png|26px]] Added '''Dante'''.|Players don't lose coins on death.|link=none}} {{History|2021/April 4|'''Dante''' was elected and perks were revealed.|link=none}} {{History|2021/April 7|link=none|Map in the [[Hub]] replaced by a message from '''Dante'''.[[File:Dante_MSG.jpg|32px]]}} {{History|2021/April 9|link=none|New addition to "Increase Security" perk: "Decreased sunlight, prevent sunburn".}} {{History|2021/April 12|Players now lose {{c}} on death.|link=none}} {{History|2021/April 14|Chatting now costs {{c|10}} per minute, {{c|5}} before.|link=none}} {{History|2021/April 16|link=none |Mining Islands, the [[Dwarven Mines]], [[Dungeon]]s, the [[Auction House]], the [[Bazaar]] and [[Pet]]s were considered safety concern and have been outlawed (canceled). |[[The Uprising]] defeated '''Dante'''. |Saying "dante" in the chat now triggers the swear filter.}} {{History|2021/May 1|link=none|Saying "dante" now no longer triggers the swear filter.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Mayors}} {{Nav/The Uprising}} {{Nav/Characters}} {{Nav/Events/Mayor Election}} [[Category:Mayor]] [[Category:Mayor Election]]

The player can right-click on any green particles surrounding objects found in the {{zone|Murder House}} to progress in [[Detective Amog]]'s reverse murder quest. The following objects in the [[Murder House]] can be investigated:
{|class="wikitable"
! Object
! Dialogue when Investigated

| {{Dialogue|
&a- Flower Pot -
&7&oThis amazing bouquet has been made with love, no doubt about that.
}}

| Blood
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Blood -
&7&oThis blood stain has been looked at before.
&7&oThat definitely spooked them quite a lot, perhaps they ran away.
&7&oBut where did they run...
}}
|-
| Ring
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Ring -
&7&oThis is clearly an engagement ring.
&7&oHowever, there is a curve on the front where there should be a jewel.
&7&oThis is incomplete.
}}
|-
| Fridge
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Fridge -
&7&oThe fridge is empty.
&7&oBut what are these?
&7&oBlockDash receipts?? Hundreds of them!
}}
|-
| Tall Painting
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Tall Painting -
&7&oIt looks like an abstract painting of our victim.
&7&oThey seem to be wearing a red-ish top and blue jeans.
}}
|-
| Window
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Window -
&7&oThe attacker might've escaped through this window!
&7&oOr one of the other windows!
&7&oOr through the door!
&7&oOr the chimney!!!
}}
|-
| Large Painting
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Large Painting -
&7&oA picture of the future wedding.
&7&oThis looks like the bride.

Examining all eight objects will allow the player to speak to {{NPCSprite|Detective Amog}} to continue the quest. The following message will be sent as well:

The '''Empty Odonata Bottle''' is an {{Uncommon}} item in the [[Rift Dimension]].

== Obtaining ==
The '''Empty Odonata Bottle''' is unlocked in the {{NPCSprite|Argofay Bugshopper}}'s shop once the player has purchased a {{Item|Larva Hook}} from them.

Once unlocked, an '''Empty Odonata Bottle''' can be purchased for {{Item|Shy Crux|amount=2}} and {{Motes|400}} from the [[NPC]].

== Usage ==
An '''Empty Odonata Bottle''' can be used to obtain a {{Item|Bottled Odonata}} by holding the bottle and looking at an {{MobSprite|Odonata}} while within a {{Green|3}} block radius of it.

The player must continue looking at the {{MobSprite|Odonata}} for {{Green|3}} seconds to successfully catch it and transform the '''Empty Odonata Bottle''' into a {{Item|Bottled Odonata}}.

The '''{{zone|Graveyard}}''' is a [[Location]] on the [[Hub Island]] found past the {{Zone|Combat Settlement}} that features low-level {{MobSprite|Graveyard Zombie}}s and a portal to the {{Zone|Spider's Den}}.

{{ZoneText|Fight Zombies.|Travel to the &cSpider's Den&f.|Talk to &7Pat&f.|Investigate the Catacombs.}}

== Purpose ==
The {{zone|Graveyard}} is home to {{MobSprite|Graveyard Zombie}}s, which spawn in during the day, and more frequently at night. Additionally, {{MobSprite|Zombie Villager}}s that spawn exclusively and frequently at night.

The back of the '''Graveyard''' contains a launch pad to the {{zone|Spider's Den}}. There are also entrances to the {{Zone|Crypts}}, {{Zone|Catacombs Entrance}}, and {{Zone|Coal Mine}}.

=== Pat's House ===
[[File:Pat's House.png|thumb|Pat's House]]
There is a house near the entrance with {{NPCSprite|Pat}} inside who sells {{Item|Flint}} and {{Item|Gravel}}.

=== Emerald Altar ===
[[File:Emerald Altar.png|thumb|The Emerald Altar]]
The '''Emerald Altar''' is a mysterious altar located in the Graveyard. It consists of {{Item|Block of Emerald|amount=2|link=}} and {{Item|Lime Stained Glass|link=}}, making a spire in the center of 8 wide pillars surrounding the spire and thus making the altar. 

When the player tries to destroy the emerald block, the following message appears:
{{Dialogue|&cThe altar doesn't budge!}}

{{NPCSprite|Romero}} is found standing next to it during the 3rd phase of his quest, where he gives you the {{Item|Fake Emerald Altar}}.

=== Dante Memorial ===
[[File:Dante Memorial.png|thumb|The Dante Memorial]]
A memorial to {{NPCSprite|Dante}} exists at {{Coordinates|-84|76|-152}}. The stone pillar structure was added into the game during the 0.8.1 Hub revamp, while the {{NPCSprite|Dante}} statue and the memorial itself was added after [[The Uprising]]. Upon interaction with the stone statue of Dante, the following chat message appears:

<!-- Spelling errors are INTENTIONAL, as they appear so in-game!
-->{{Dialogue|
&7In Memoriam
&fWhile Dante will be remembered as a cruel tyrant, his righteous ideals live on in people's hearts.
&fdante &6best&7.
}}

source_pages.title: Lotus Atoll
source_pages.raw_wikitext:
{{Infobox/Location |type = {{Skl|Fishing|Island}} |level = {{Skill|Fishing|10}} |image= {{InfoboxGallery |image1 = Lotus Atoll.png|label1 = Island |image2 = Lotus Atoll (0.25) (Top View).png|label2 = Top View }} |prev_location=[[Backwater Bayou]] |level {{Skill|Fishing|10}} |sublocations = * [[Lotus Eater's Cave]] * [[Lotus Highlands]] * [[Tewtil Tunnel]] |travel_scroll = [[Travel Scroll to the Lotus Atoll]] |mobs = * Atoll Croaker * Drowned Captain * Flipflopper * Frog Prince * gorF * Lotum * Lotus Guardian * Lotusfish * Puddle Jumper * Seashine * Tewtil |drops = |resources = }} {{For|the temporary promotional NPC|Lotus Atoll (NPC)}} The '''Lotus Atoll''' is a {{Skl|Fishing}} [[Locations|Location]] and the second island that can be accessed from [[Ship Navigator]]. It is unlocked by reaching {{Skill|Fishing|10}} and speaking to {{NPCSprite|Researcher Gilbert}} on the {{Zone|Backwater Bayou}}. {{ZoneText|Learn about &2Trophy Frogs &ffrom &2Researcher Ribery&f.|Catch the &212 species &fof Trophy Frog.|Trade Frogs with &2Researcher Ribery &fin exchange for &aLotus&f.|Progress through the &aLotus Collection&f!}} == Features == The '''Lotus Atoll''' is a [[Fishing]]-oriented location, with a variety of unique features resolving around progress in the skill. === Chapters === The '''Lotus Atoll''' contains [[Chapters]], which consist of {{Yellow|47}} tasks for the player to complete. Completing all these tasks rewards the {{Item|Pearl of the Lotus}}, which grants a permanent {{Stat|trophy chance|+2.5}}. These chapters can be accessed by speaking to {{NPCSprite|Researcher Betty}}. {{:Chapters/Lotus Atoll}} === Sea Creatures === The '''Lotus Atoll''' contains a variety of unique [[Sea Creatures]] to be caught. {{:Sea Creatures/List/Lotus}} === Treasure === {{Main|Treasure#Lotus Atoll}} '''Lotus Atoll''' has a unique [[Treasure#Lotus Atoll|Treasure Fishing]] loot table. === Critters === Aside from [[Sea Creatures]], there are various [[Critters]] that can be found on the '''Lotus Atoll''', all of which are tied to [[Hunting]] and cannot be damaged regularly: * {{MobSprite|Lotusfish}}, which can be found swimming in the water and caught with a [[Fishing Nets|Fishing Net]] to obtain the {{Item|Lotusfish Shard}}. * {{MobSprite|Lotum}}s, which can be found around the water. When punched 4 times (or 3 times with {{Attr|Frog Legs}}), they grant the {{Item|Lotum Shard}}. * {{MobSprite|Tewtil}}s, which can be found in the water and primarily in the {{Zone|Tewtil Tunnel}}. When fed three [[Trophy Frog]]s, they explode and grant the {{Item|Tewtil Shard}}. * {{MobSprite|Flipflopper}}s, which have a {{Green|50%}} chance to spawn from an [[Exploding Lily Pad]]. They can be damaged with a {{Item|Medium Fishing Net}} or better. * {{MobSprite|Seashine}}s, which have a {{Green|25%}} chance to spawn from an [[Exploding Lily Pad]]. They can also be damaged with a {{Item|Medium Fishing Net}} or better. === Lotus Collection === {{Main|Lotus}} {{Item|Lotus}} is a [[Collection]] that is obtained exclusively on the '''Lotus Atoll'''. It features items that make it easier to catch [[Trophy Frogs]]. {{CollectionTable|Lotus}} === Trophy Frogs === {{Main|Trophy Frog}} [[Trophy Frogs]] are a type of item that can be caught exclusively on the '''Lotus Atoll'''. Like [[Trophy Fish]], each type of Trophy Frog comes in four tiers: {{Dark Gray|'''BRONZE'''}}, {{Gray|'''SILVER'''}}, {{Gold|'''GOLD'''}}, and {{Aqua|'''DIAMOND'''}}, with higher tiers being harder to catch. {{:Trophy Frogs/List}} === Wormholes === [[File:Lotus Atoll Wormhole.png|thumb|256px|A Wormhole under a bridge near the spawn area.]] {{Main|Wormhole}} [[Wormhole]]s are purple particle rings that can be seen in the '''Lotus Atoll''' and {{Zone|Crimson Isle}} while wearing {{Item|Froggles}}, {{Item|Silver Froggles}}, {{Item|Golden Froggles}}, or {{Item|Diamond Froggles}}. While fishing in them, players have a chance to catch the {{Item|Reality Hopper}} [[Trophy Frog]]. Higher tier Froggles and the {{Item|Geometric Oddity}} also grant {{Stat|trophy chance}} and higher chances at {{Gold|'''GOLD'''}} and {{Aqua|'''DIAMOND'''}} [[Trophy Frogs]]. Additionally, fishing inside a [[Wormhole]] prevents [[Sea Creatures]] from being caught. === Exploding Lily Pads === [[File:Giant Lily Pad.png|thumb|256px|A large lily pad right before explosion.]] The water in the '''Lotus Atoll''' not only contains {{Item|Lily Pad}}s placed as blocks, but also lily pads that can be punched around on the water. If two Lily Pads of different sizes get close together, the smaller one will be absorbed by the larger one, which also increases the size of the larger Lily Pad. Once a single Lily Pad reaches size 8, it will float into the air, spin, and then explode. The explosion grants the following rewards to all players within 30 blocks who interacted with the Lily Pad (including merged Lily Pads) during the past 180 seconds: * {{Item|Exploding Frog}} [[Trophy Frog]] * {{Item|Lily Pad|amount=120-180}}s{{confirm}} * {{Item|Lotus|amount=60-100}} * {{Skill XP|+120 Fishing}} After a Lily Pad explodes, 3-5 [[Sea Creatures#Lotus|Lotus Sea Creatures]] spawn based on the sum of the participating players' {{Stat|Tracking}} (up to {{Staticon|Tracking|400}}{{Confirm}}). Each Sea Creature targets a random participating player. There is also a {{Green|50%}} base chance to spawn a {{MobSprite|Flipflopper}} and a {{Green|25%}} base chance to spawn {{MobSprite|Seashine}}, which can be increased by the participants' {{Stat|Tracking}}. {{Attr|Lily Tracker}} [[Attribute]] grants {{Stat|Tracking}} on Exploding Lily Pads and {{Attr|Lily Puncher}} [[Attribute]] gives more force when punching them. {{Dialogue| &b&l▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ &a&lLILY-SPLOSION! &a&lREWARDS &fLily Pad &8x# &aLotus &8x# &3+# Fishing Experience &aExploding Frog &7&l &b&l▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬ }} File:Pushable lily pads next to normal lily pads.png|A group of pushable lily pads next to normal lily pads. File:Giant Lily Pad.png|A large lily pad right before explosion. File:Giant Lily Pad floating up.png|A lily pad spinning in the air before exploding. [[File:Fishing Hot Spot in Lotus Atoll.png|thumb|256px|An example of a hotspot in the Lotus Atoll.]] === Hotspots === [[Fishing Hotspots|Hotspots]] appear in water to grant buffs and new [[Sea Creatures]] when the player's bobber is within. === Weather === Every {{Green|40}} minutes on the '''Lotus Atoll''', {{Green|20}} minutes of rain begins. While raining, players gain {{stat|fs|+25}} and can catch {{Item|Wetlands Frog}}s. Occasionally, rain may become a thunderstorm. It provides no additional effect.{{confirm}} == Zones == {{:Locations/Lotus Atoll}} == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Fairy Souls == {{Fairy Souls}} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/May 6/2|version=None|Added '''Lotus Atoll'''.}} {{History|2026/May 14|version=None|Added thunderstorms to '''Lotus Atoll'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.23|Announced that '''Lotus Atoll''' will be the next [[Fishing Island]] and that it will feature Trophy Frogs.}} {{history|0.23.3|Announced that the upcoming [[Guardian Slayer]] will not be part of '''Lotus Atoll''', but will be on [[Desecrated Shrine|another island]], due to '''Lotus Atoll''' introducing a new system.|Revealed that both Guardian Slayer and '''Lotus Atoll''' are deep in development.}} {{History|2025/Dec 28|link=https://hypixel.net/threads/skyblock-2025-recap.6029835/|Planned release window for '''Lotus Atoll''' was stated to be in 2026.}} {{history|2026/March 23|link=https://hypixel.net/threads/sneak-peek-lotus-atoll.6000454/|Released a Sneak Peek for '''Lotus Atoll''', revealing many of its features: * Lotus Sea Creatures * introduction for Trophy Fishing for early game players, using [[Trophy Frogs]] * Ship Crew — who's members accessed via a quest and will grant a small bonus to [[Fishing]] * Chapters, akin to [[Hina's Chapters]] * Golden Pearl — reward for finishing the final Chapter |Narrowed the release window to April or May 2026.}} {{History|0.24.4|Declared that '''Lotus Atoll''' will release sometime in late May 2026.}} {{History|0.24.5|Revealed that the '''Lotus Atoll''' will be the next update, and that it will hit [[Alpha Hypixel Network]] "''very soon''".}} {{History|0.25|Added '''Lotus Atoll'''.}} {{History|2026/Oct 5|Biome sky colors and particles are now correctly displayed in islands like the {{Zone|Torrhus Canyon}}.}} }} == References == {{Cite Discord | url = https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529856177427448008/1529873874055987401 | staff = yes | user = mrkeith | channel = admin-info-requests | date = July 23, 2026, 11:32 AM (EST) | text = sum the tracking value of all online participants
spawn 3-5 sea creatures as if a player with that amount of tracking (and no other stats) fished them up

a participant is a player that has interacted with the lily pad or any lilies combined and is within 30 blocks at time of explosion. lily pads clear participants after 180s* of inactivity }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Locations}}

{{Infobox/Item |type = Consumable item |rarity = uncommon |collection = Mushroom 4 |lore = Consuming this Magical Mushroom Soup on your private island allows the player to fly for {{Green|2 minutes}}. Leaving the private island will pause the effect! |auctionable = n |sell = 4 |raw_materials = *3x [[Planks]] *1x [[Red Mushroom]] *1x [[Brown Mushroom]] *1x [[Redstone Dust]] *1x [[Glowstone Dust]] |mat_cost_bazaar = *1x Dark Oak Wood *1x Red Mushroom *1x Brown Mushroom *1x Redstone *1x Glowstone Dust |upgrades_to = Mystical Mushroom Soup |bazaar = Magical Mushroom Soup |id = MAGIC_MUSHROOM_SOUP }} '''Magical Mushroom Soup''' is an {{Uncommon}} consumable item unlocked in {{CollectionLink|Mushroom|4}} that allows players to fly on their {{zone|Private Island}} and {{zone|The Garden}} for 2 minutes. You can also use it while guesting someone else's Private Island or Garden. This soup can be a cheaper flight substitute for players without a {{Item|Booster Cookie}}. However, the flight duration is limited and you should be aware if it is about to run out and drink more preemptively. It functions the same as {{Item|Mystical Mushroom Soup}}, giving you the ability to fly on player islands for 2 minutes instead of 200 minutes, but materials to craft it cost only 1/160th of Mystical Mushroom Soup. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{CollectionLink|Mushroom 4}} |A1 = |B1 = Glowstone Dust |C1 = |A2 = Red Mushroom |B2 = Brown Mushroom |C2 = Redstone Dust |A3 = |B3 = Bowl |C3 = |Output = Magical Mushroom Soup }} }} == Usage == When right-clicked, the '''Magical Mushroom Soup''' is consumed, triggering its ability. When consumed, the Magical Mushroom Soup gives the player 2 minutes of flight only on their [[Private Island]] and also makes them invulnerable to fall damage. When the effects are active, players will have multi-colored particles around them. If the player leaves the island when the Magical Mushroom Soup effects are still active, the timer will pause until the player returns to the island. The time of flight left can be extended by consuming additional soup. Warning messages will trigger when there is/are 60, 30, 10, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 second(s) left and when the effect runs out. == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Random Message |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYou can now fly for &c2 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYou can now fly for &c2 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYou can now fly for &c2 &aminutes. }} |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming when
already active |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYour flight has been extended for &c2 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYour flight has been extended for &c2 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYour flight has been extended for &c2 &aextra minutes. }} |- |class="ct" |Effect about to expire |{{Dialogue|&cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e10s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e5s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e4s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e3s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e2s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e1s &cMushroom Soup Flight has expired!}} |} == Trivia == *When Magical Mushroom Soup was added, there was a bug that allowed people to use the item on the [[Hub Island]]. It was fixed shortly after. *The texture of the Magical Mushroom Soup is based on the [[terraria:Grub Soup|Grub Soup]] from Terraria. *The Magical Mushroom Soup used to have a different appearance and gave the Nausea effect when consumed. **The Nausea effect has been removed and Magical Mushroom Soup was given a different appearance and not considered a Mushroom Soup from vanilla Minecraft. **The custom Magical Mushroom Soup was added because the vanilla Mushroom Soup interfered with the mechanics of the soup and caused it to not stack when crafted. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|0.4|[[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] Added '''Magical Mushroom Soup'''.}} {{History|2019/June 29|Added a limit to how far you can fly away from your island.}} {{History|2019/August 2|Give Nausea effect for 1 less second.}} {{History|2020/June 2|Flight duration is now saved when leaving private islands. Limit of one hour of flight is lifted.}} {{History|2021/Oct 13|Changed from an actual mushroom soup item to a custom head item, as well as changed texture from [[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] to [[File:Magical Mushroom Soup.png|26px]].|Removed Nausea effect.}} {{History|0.18.3|Added '''Magical Mushroom Soup''' to the [[Bazaar]].}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Collection/Mushroom}}

source_pages.title: Minister Election
source_pages.raw_wikitext:
{{Historical|update=January 13, 2026}}
{{See also|Candidate Aura}}

The '''Minister Election''' is an election event that replaces the [[Mayor Election]] while {{NPCSprite|Candidate Aura;Aura}} is in office. It takes place in {{Zone|The People's Voting}}, a room that replaced the {{Zone|Election Room}}.

A player can vote on other players to become Ministers. The {{Green|7}} Ministers with the most votes will be able to add their own perks to the game: the top {{Green|3}} Ministers may create their own perks, whereas the remaining {{Green|4}} Ministers may choose from different Mayor perks and special pre-made perks.

The player cannot vote for {{NPCSprite|Candidate Aura;Aura}}, anyone with the {{Rank|staff}} rank, {{RankName|Pig|Technoblade}}, or blacklisted individuals like {{RankName|default|dante}}, {{RankName|MVP+|hannibal2|plus_color=5}}, or {{RankName|MVP+|Minikloon|plus_color=c}}. Ministers cannot be voted in two elections in a row, unless they use the {{AN|Long Term Investment}} perk; likewise, players who managed to reach the podium cannot be voted for in subsequent elections.

When a Minister Election concludes, the following message will display:

{{Dialogue|
&6&lATTENTION! &aThe #th Minister Election has concluded!
&eYour winners are:
&e1st: &7<playername>
&e2nd: &7<playername>
&e3rd: &7<playername>
&e4th: &7<playername>
&e5th: &7<playername>
&e6th: &7<playername>
&e7th: &7<playername>
}}

* {{RankName|MVP+|hannibal2|plus_color=5}} was blacklisted from being able to be voted for after a developer of the popular mod SkyHanni auto-filled the sign where players could vote on a minister with <code>hannibal2</code>, which counted as a chat macro: the developer behind this was also temporarily banned.
* {{RankName|YouTube|im_a_squid_kid}}, {{RankName|MVP|Confused_Goon}} and {{RankName|MVP++|SnowflakeKiwi|plus_color=9|bracket_color=b}} chose to use their perks to remove the {{AN|Minion Union}}, {{AN|Work Harder}} and {{AN|Work Smarter}} perks, respectively. As a result, they were imprisoned in the {{Zone|Prison of the Bereft}} and replaced with an {{NPCSprite|Electoral Goon}} for the duration of their term.
* {{RankName|MVP++|AscentPVP|plus_color=3}} was disqualified from the fifth election for bribing people with giveaways and invited to campaign again under the pretense that no money would be involved.
* {{RankName|YouTube|Future77}}'s '''Organ Donor''' perk is a reference to a running gag where Future77 jokes about selling his organs to afford the coins to 'hypermax' items in SkyBlock.
* While the '''Work Harder''' perk affects the {{stat|hp}} values shown in [[Bestiary]] of mobs, it doesn't change the {{stat|dmg}} value, which is also increased by the perk.
** {{NPCSprite|Derpy}}'s '''DOUBLE MOBS HP!!!''' doesn't change values in Bestiary.
** Slayer menu shows both increases to Boss's {{stat|HP}}, but omits the {{stat|Damage}}.
* After the {{Item|Precursor Drone Pet}}, {{Item|Kuudra Tentacle}}, {{Item|Blood God Sigil}}, and {{Item|Potato Ring}} were added, new items stopped being added after the conclusion of each individual Minister Election. Instead, they were slowly rolled out over time and eventually in one major update.
* {{RN|MVP+|arithemonkey}}'s perk, which was to add a 2nd [[Bingo#Secret Bingo|Secret Bingo]] to the game, was implemented on March 29th, 2026: {{Green|3}} days before the beginning of April.
* {{RN|YT|Derailious}}'s perk was originally the '''Magical Milk Mixin''', however with the implementation of {{Item|Celestial Mason Jar}} which granted the same perk, his perk was changed.
* {{RN|MVP+|Luamon}}'s perk, which was implemented as part of the [[Loadouts]] system, was first seen on the [[Alpha Hypixel Network]] on June 24th, 2026.

{{Infobox/Item |type = Consumable item |rarity = rare |collection = Mushroom 7 |lore = Consuming this Magical Mushroom Soup on your private island allows the player to fly for {{Green|200 minutes}}. Leaving the private island will pause the effect! |sell = 640 |bazaar = Mystical Mushroom Soup |raw_materials = 3 Planks *160 Red Mushroom *160 Brown Mushroom *160 Redstone *160 Glowstone Dust |mat_cost_bazaar = *1x Dark Oak Wood *1x Enchanted Red Mushroom *1x Enchanted Brown Mushroom *1x Enchanted Redstone Dust *1x Enchanted Glowstone Dust |auctionable = n |upgrades_from = Magical Mushroom Soup |id = SUPER_MAGIC_MUSHROOM_SOUP }} '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' is a {{Rare}} consumable unlocked in {{CollectionLink|Mushroom 7}} that allows players to fly on [[Private Island]]s. == Usage == When consumed, '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' gives the player 200 minutes of flight on private islands. It also makes them invulnerable to fall damage while on their private island, which is useful when building farms. This soup can be a cheaper flight substitute for players without a [[Booster Cookie]]. However, the flight duration is limited and one should be aware if it is about to run out and drink more preemptively, or else you will fall and take damage or possibly die. The flight duration can be extended by consuming additional soup. Mystical Mushroom Soup's duration will pause when leaving the island, resuming when one returns. Warning messages will trigger when there are 60, 30, 10, 5, 4, 3, 2, and 1 second(s) left and when the effect runs out. == Obtaining == Mystical Mushroom Soup can be obtained through crafting. === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Mushroom 7}} |A1 = |B1 = Enchanted Glowstone Dust |C1 = |A2 = Enchanted Red Mushroom |B2 = Enchanted Brown Mushroom |C2 = Enchanted Redstone Dust |A3 = |B3 = Bowl |C3 = |Output = Mystical Mushroom Soup }} }} == Game Message == {| class="wikitable" ! Condition ! Random Message |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYou can now fly for &c200 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYou can now fly for &c200 &aminutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYou can now fly for &c200 &aminutes. }} |- |rowspan="3" class="ct" |Consuming when
already active |{{Dialogue| &e&oHmm... tasty! &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oI feel like I can fly! &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |{{Dialogue| &e&oWhat was in that soup? &aYour flight has been extended for &c200 &aextra minutes. }} |- |class="ct" |Effect about to expire |{{Dialogue|&cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e10s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e5s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e4s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e3s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e2s &cMushroom Soup Flight expires in &e1s &cMushroom Soup Flight has expired!}} |} == Trivia == * This was announced by a former {{RN|a|Dctr}}, on June 4th, 2020. * Although it requires 160 times as many resources as [[Magical Mushroom Soup]], it lasts 100 times as long, making it a less efficient use of resources. * It was previously known as "Super Magical Mushroom Soup". * The max flight duration is about 596,523 hours, or 2,147,483,647 seconds, which is the 32-bit signed integer limit. This amount of soup would cost {{BZC|*33555 Oak Wood *178957 Enchanted Redstone Dust *178957 Enchanted Glowstone Dust *178957 Enchanted Brown Mushroom *178957 Enchanted Red Mushroom}}.  ** This record was discovered and reached by Cekofari. Upon reaching this limit, the flight duration timer disappears, flying gets disabled, and eating additional soup does not re-enable flight. The only known way to regain flight on the private island is to eat a booster cookie. *The first record was held by Zylenox, who had gotten 520,000 hours of flight, which he explained would last until he died in real lifehttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6oatMZva0jU&t=85s. **The next record was held by MaybeMoshi who beat Zylenox's record with 521,001 hourshttps://hypixel.net/threads/mushroom-soup-record-broken.5342206/. **This record was ultimately broken by Cekofari when he hit the limit of 596,523 hours. * The Mystical Mushroom Soup used to have a different appearance and gave the Nausea effect when consumed. ** The Nausea effect has been removed and Mystical Mushroom Soup was given a different appearance and not considered a Mushroom Soup from vanilla Minecraft. ** The custom Mystical Mushroom Soup was added because the vanilla Mushroom Soup interfered with the mechanics of the soup and caused it to not stack when crafted. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2020/June 4|link=https://hypixel.net/threads/june-4-super-magical-mushroom-soup.2970703/|[[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] Added '''Super Magical Mushroom Soup'''.|Renamed item to '''Mystical Mushroom Soup'''.}} {{History|2021/Oct 13|Changed from an actual mushroom soup item to a custom head item, as well as changed texture from [[File:Magical Mushroom Soup (old).png|26px]] to [[File:Mystical Mushroom Soup.png|26px]].|Removed Nausea Effect.}} {{History|0.18.3|Added '''Mystical Mushroom Soup''' to the [[Bazaar]].}} }} == References == == Navigation == {{Nav/Collection/Mushroom}}

{{Infobox/Dungeon enemy |stats = {{InfoboxMobStats |health = 4-6 }} |category = Boss |mob_type = *{{mt|Cubic}} *{{mt|Arcane}} |spawn_location = [[The Catacombs - Floor IV]] |special_behavior = Summons Spirit Animals |mob_level = 1 |description = {{gray|Shaman Necromancer}}
Powerful Necromancer who specializes in animals. Calls himself a vegetarian, go figure. |id = THORN_1, MASTER_THORN_1 }} {{For|the Enchantment {{Ench|Thorns}}|Thorns}} '''Thorn '''is the {{mcat|b}} of [[The Catacombs - Floor IV]]. He is a ghast which spawns animals and can only be damaged by his Spirit Bow. Thorn's remains re-appear on [[The Catacombs - Floor V|Floor V]], from which [[Livid]] drains energy in order to clone himself. == Collection == Killing Thorn increases the Thorn collection. {{CollectionTable|Thorn}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == === Overview === Unlike most of the other bosses in The Catacombs, Thorn only has one apparent phase, same as Livid, however technically has different phases, but the differences are minuscule. Thorn will speed up the more he has been damaged and when he is about to die in one more hit, Thorn will start turning around, making it harder to hit him. Additionally, with each wave that comes, the Spirit Animals gain more HP, overall making it a longer fight. After {{Green|15s}} of dialogue, Thorn will summon Spirit Animals which can deal damage to the player along with a new {{mcat|miniboss}} called the Spirit Bear. A counter (indicated by a ring of [[Sea Lantern]]s and [[Block of Coal|Coal Blocks]] near the audience) shows how many Spirit Animals have been killed. When the ring fully lights up with Sea Lanterns, the Spirit Bear will spawn. There is a crowd of enemies cheering for Thorn in the arena. While they can't attack the player, they can give helpful hints for Thorn's attacks. Although, if the player enters the crowds viewing area, swarms of spirit bats will attack the player and deal large quantities of damage. Occasionally, one of the circles in the arena will change color, either green or orange. If it turns green, it will ready up a Healing Circle much like the Healer's one, but if it turns orange, it will start a fire on that circle. Thorn's spirit animals will take 5% of their HP every second they are in the fire. === Spirit Bear === The Spirit Bear is a {{mcat|mb}} summoned during the fight. It will be summoned once 25 Spirit Animals (or 30 in Master Mode) have been killed. It has {{hp|5M}} (or {{hp|180M}} in Master Mode) and can attack players with a Golden Sword or a Spirit Bow. The spirit bear will heal overtime, but very slowly. When the Spirit Bear is killed, it drops a Spirit Bow. The player who picks it up only gets one chance to shoot Thorn. Each successful hit stuns Thorn for {{Green|5s}}, followed by a {{Green|1s}} cooldown before Thorn can be damaged again. Every hit from the Spirit Bow removes {{hp|1}} from Thorn’s health. Once Thorn’s health reaches zero, they die. === Summoned Mobs === Throughout the fight, various Spirit Mobs will spawn in. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Bull}} - These rush towards the player to attack them. They also have a charge attack, dealing {{Red|30%}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}} in regular mode ({{Stat|Damage|846.6|icononly=yes}}) and {{Red|75%}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}} in [[Master Mode]] ({{Stat|Damage|53,550|icononly=yes}}). * {{MobSprite|Spirit Wolf}} - These will swarm players and attack them in large quantities. They deal {{Red|3.5x}} damage to players using the [[Tank]] [[Class]]. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Bat}} - These will swarm players who are in the air. They do not respect player invincibility frames. This means if a player jumps in the air and is swarmed by bats, they will be mowed to death in seconds. Can be deterred by decoys as they have no vanilla attacking ability and cannot destroy it. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Rabbit}} - These will attack the player, launching them in the air, and then run away. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Chicken}} - These slowly descends to the ground, strike nearby players with lightning. If it touches the ground, it will turn into a Chicken Mine. Players who walk over it take damage and are knocked into the air. The lightning attacks deal {{Red|1.5x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|1,392|icononly=yes}}) in regular mode, and {{Red|0.35x}} the base {{Stat|Damage}} ({{Stat|Damage|9,408|icononly=yes}}) in [[Master Mode]]. * {{MobSprite|Spirit Sheep}} - These run toward the player and explodes like a creeper. This deals up to {{Red|0.2x}} of the base {{Stat|Damage}}, or {{Stat|Damage|3,808|icononly=yes}} in regular mode and {{Stat|Damage|133,280|icononly=yes}} in [[Master Mode]], with the amount depending on close the player was to the explosion.{{Confirm}} {{Mob Table| {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bear}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bull}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Wolf}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Bat}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Rabbit}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Chicken}} {{Mob Table Row|Spirit Sheep}} }} == Drops == Killing Thorn will complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor IV/Loot}} [[Master Mode]] Loot: {{:The Catacombs - Floor IV/Master Mode Loot}} == Dialogue == === Thorn === {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Intro |{{Dialogue| &c[BOSS] Thorn&f: Welcome Adventurers! You can't just beat Thorn! &bCROWD&f: Pack it up boys...nothing to see here... &bCROWD&f: Another 2020 catastrophe. &bCROWD&f: OOF }} |- |} == Strategies == {{Main|Tutorials/Dungeon Ultimate Guide#Thorn}} == Trivia == *The [[Spirit Bow]] used in the Thorn fight has some extra lore attached to it. {{Slot|Spirit Bow}} *Thorn's remains are seen in during the [[Livid]] boss fight in the form of a purple orb (|''This Orb you see, is Thorn, or what is left of him.''"). *The Spirit Bow specifically does approximately {{stat|dmg|75,000}} per hit against Thorn. *One of '''Thorn''''s lines is "Round and round, another wound." which might have been intended to rhyme, even though it does not. *The dialogue of '''Thorn's''' crowd contains many references. **"''Another 2020 catastrophe.''" references the [[w:COVID-19|COVID-19 pandemic]]. **"''Killing a spirit...what kind of man does that? ... No man at all.''" references ''Breaking Bad'', in which Gustavo Fring asks Hector Salamanca "''What kind of man talks to the DEA? Notably, Bonzo is a circus clown and Thorn hosts a performance. **"''My disappointment is immeasurable and my day is ruined.''" references the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/my-disappointment-is-immeasurable-and-my-day-is-ruined quote of the same name], in which host of TheReportOfTheWeek, Reviewbrah, says the exact quote after tasting Popeyes' cheddar biscuit butterfly shrimp. **''"Fs in the chat!''" is a reference to the meme [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/press-f-to-pay-respects originating from 2014's Call of Duty Advanced Wafare], where there is an event in the campaign where you have to "Press F to pay respects", which eventually has been used by gamers in the event of a huge loss. ==Tips== *There is currently a bug that allows players can stun '''Thorn''' in place using a {{Item|Tribal Spear}} or {{Item|Bonemerang}}. This is commonly used by players to make the bossfight easier. **Attempting to stun '''Thorn''' but failing the stun whilst Thorn is still alive will make '''Thorn''' will become extremely fast. This is because when '''Thorn''' gets hit with the [[Tribal Spear]] or [[Bonemerang]] it treats it like he got hit with the [[Spirit Bow (Thorn)|Spirit Bow]] which increases his speed. **The {{Item|Terminator}}'s "{{an|Salvation}}" ability can also cause him to reach this state but it is much more difficult, since the ability can only be cast after landing {{green|3}} hits with the bow. == Gallery == Thorn Orb.png|'''Thorn'''{{'}}s remains during the [[Livid]] boss fight == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2020/July 30|[[File:Thorn.png|26px]] Added '''Thorn'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Catacombs}} [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Boss Collections]]

The '''Fruit Bowl''' is a {{Rare}} item.

== Obtaining ==
A '''Fruit Bowl''' has a {{Green|0.2%}} ({{Green|1}} in {{Green|500}}) chance to be rewarded from completing a [[Garden]] visitor offer.

'''Fruit Bowl''' can also be obtained as a Minor Reward during [[Raffle of the Century]] event, or from the {{Item|Gift Bag of the Century}}.

==Usage== 
The player can click on any other player while holding a '''Fruit Bowl''' to add the name of their profile to the item. 
{{TextSection|boxed=true|text={{Dialogue|
&a&lFRUIT BOWL! &b<player>&e's profile name is &a<profile>&e!
&a<profile> has been added to the fruit bowl!
}}}}

If the profile name has already been found, the result will be:
{{TextSection|boxed=true|text={{Dialogue|
&a&lFRUIT BOWL! &b<player>&e's profile name is &a<profile>&e!
&6You already found this profile name in your bowl!
}}}}

Finding each default profile name will reset the item and grant the player a permanent {{stat|farming wisdom|+1}} and {{coins|250,000}}. The player may only gain the bonus once.

blocks.payload_raw:

Additionally, fishing inside a [[Wormhole]] prevents [[Sea Creatures]] from being caught.

=== Exploding Lily Pads ===
[[File:Giant Lily Pad.png|thumb|256px|A large lily pad right before explosion.]]
The water in the '''Lotus Atoll''' not only contains {{Item|Lily Pad}}s placed as blocks, but also lily pads that can be punched around on the water. If two Lily Pads of different sizes get close together, the smaller one will be absorbed by the larger one, which also increases the size of the larger Lily Pad. Once a single Lily Pad reaches size 8, it will float into the air, spin, and then explode. The explosion grants the following rewards to all players within 30 blocks who interacted with the Lily Pad (including merged Lily Pads) during the past 180 seconds:<ref name="lily-pad-spawns"/>
* {{Item|Exploding Frog}} [[Trophy Frog]]
* {{Item|Lily Pad|amount=120-180}}s{{confirm}}
* {{Item|Lotus|amount=60-100}}
* {{Skill XP|+120 Fishing}}

After a Lily Pad explodes, 3-5 [[Sea Creatures#Lotus|Lotus Sea Creatures]] spawn based on the sum of the participating players' {{Stat|Tracking}} (up to {{Staticon|Tracking|400}}{{Confirm}}). Each Sea Creature targets a random participating player.<ref name="lily-pad-spawns"/>
There is also a {{Green|50%}} base chance to spawn a {{MobSprite|Flipflopper}} and a {{Green|25%}} base chance to spawn {{MobSprite|Seashine}}, which can be increased by the participants' {{Stat|Tracking}}.

{{Attr|Lily Tracker}} [[Attribute]] grants {{Stat|Tracking}} on Exploding Lily Pads and {{Attr|Lily Puncher}} [[Attribute]] gives more force when punching them.

By talking with [[Dr. Emmett]] in this room, you can fast travel to any Puzzle that has been previously completed, including the reward room.

=== Second Puzzle ===
The second room requires the player to follow a path to cross the floor. The player's side of the floor is blank. In the mirror's reflection is [[lava]], with a winding path of {{Item|Block of Iron|text=Iron Block}}s. The player must follow the path without stepping into lava. If the player steps onto lava, it will send the player back to the beginning.

=== Third Puzzle ===
The third room requires the player to craft a {{Item|remmaH yniT}}. The player's side of the room is blank. In the mirror's reflection there is a {{Item|Crafting Table}} located in front of the mirror and multiple mobs scattered across the floor. The player must kill the mobs based on their mirrored location in order to obtain the drops needed to craft multiple items.

Baby zombies will drop {{Item|knalP dooW kaO}}, cave spiders drop {{Item|gnirtS}} and slimes will drop {{Item|llabemilS}}. All the drops can be crafted into items, which can then be crafted into a {{Item|remmaH yniT}}.

=== Fourth Puzzle ===
The fourth room requires the player to cross a room using parkour. The player's side of the room is filled with wooden platforms, with [[lava]] underneath. In the mirror's reflection, which now lays above the main area, there is only a selection of platforms, consisting of those that are safe for the player to stand on to cross the room. Approaching an incorrect platform will cause it to vanish. If the player comes in contact with [[lava]], they will be flung into the air. {{Historical article|update=January 19, 2026}} {{Infobox/Location |location=[[Hub Island]] |npcs= *Confused Goon (player);Confused Goon *im_a_squid_kid *SnowflakeKiwi }} The '''Prison of the Bereft''' was a location found on the [[Hub Island]] while {{NPCSprite|Candidate Aura;Aura}} was in office.
